method: Interactive playtest in the in-app browser, using the unsaved utilities preview with interactions, noon lighting and land seed 42. No player save was changed.

lenses.observed: Selected Workshop from Find on map, switched it off, observed the marker/list become Switched off, and switched it back on.

Exercised drinking water, irrigation, greywater and sewage filters. Compared inventories. Fixed empty wastewater tanks being marked as shortages; retested healthy empty sewage and drinking-water shortages.
Empty state initially. Placed a Gathering place through the build catalog; it appeared with Supplies 0/3 and 0 in transit.
lenses.limit: Did not wait for manual construction completion; removal of completed projects is covered by the data regression check.

lenses.observed: 88 deposits and trees listed, with distinct remaining quantities for deposits. Selected an Embauba and queued cutting through the normal inspector.
Five resident markers, with Iara and Bento flagged at 10% energy. Selecting Iara centered the camera on her. Live activities later changed to rest/carry.
Distances labeled as straight-line estimates. At 1x, path count changed from zero to five and a carrying resident displayed a path. Supply focus and resident activities matched the scene.
Selected the idle Vegetable garden and started a batch. The lens updated from No job queued to Plant and harvest vegetables queued. Shared food counts were displayed.
Toilet displayed sewage 10/16 and greywater 0/16, matching its building inspector. Empty waste stores showed available space.
Garden, animal and queued felling jobs displayed with assigned-worker counts. Resident needs remained visible.
Gentle, moderate and steep colors rendered on seeded relief. Fixed hover being limited to sample centers; retested multiple points within one colored tile and saw consistent elevation/slope details.

House showed meals 43 cells away, usable washing 13 cells away, toilet 0 cells away and leisure 6 cells away. Its inspector confirmed the home had no fresh water, so washing correctly referred elsewhere.
Cutting queued through the resource inspector changed the selected tree from Standing tree to Marked for felling, with a yellow marker.

Switched between timber and ingredients; upstream raw-wood sources and direct consumers/producers changed. Fixed the 81-line timber fan: all 82 locations remain, with one direct shared-stock connection in this fixture.

remaining_observations: The seeded simulation at 4x caused browser input timeouts. Normal 1x running and paused interactions worked. The cause was not isolated; no high-speed performance claim is made.
This is a targeted lens playtest, not a full-game endurance test.
checks: Data regression script passed, including full wastewater storage, nonmutating reads, urgent needs, completion removal, filters and upstream markers.
No browser error logs were returned at the end of the interactive pass.
